edit.description: buildPriorAttempt's gate-revert `details` uses tailBound() (already used for voluntary-bail) instead of bound(), per spec/loop.md's digest-not-transcript framing.
Pin that a gate-revert PriorAttempt's details preserve tail content when raw details exceed MAX_PRIOR_DETAILS.

summary: buildPriorAttempt() truncates gate-revert `details` head-first (bound()), discarding trailing content — twice this session it cut vitest's Failed Tests block, the section a retry needs most.

per.section: Prior-outcome feedback to the retrying tick

tests: a gate-revert PriorAttempt whose raw details exceeds MAX_PRIOR_DETAILS keeps its trailing content rather than losing it to head-first truncation
acceptance: buildPriorAttempt's gate-revert details use tailBound(); a synthetic details string with distinctive content only in its last few hundred chars, and total length over MAX_PRIOR_DETAILS, retains that content in the persisted PriorAttempt record.
notes: Two same-day gate-reverts (752346f, 8da2af6/69d0214) left the failing test unidentifiable from disk: bound() kept ~KB of leading PASS noise and cut vitest's Failed Tests block. tailBound() already exists for this exact reason (voluntary-bail). Vitest-specific FAIL-block regex extraction was considered and set aside per engine-boundary.md 'Told, not inferred' — reusing the generic tail-bias helper needs no tool-specific parsing.

edit.description: Harden or relocate the parallelism-probe assertion (~L2712-2865) so it no longer depends on two mock invocations overlapping within a fixed 50ms window under load.

summary: The afterMerge fanout 'ships the N-1 clean siblings' test asserts maxInFlight===2 off a bare 50ms overlap window (L2764/L2785) — a load-flake candidate for the default lane's gate-revert pattern.

per.section: The default test lane must stay fast

tests: the fanout afterMerge fixture's concurrency assertion holds deterministically under CPU contention, without depending on a fixed short real-time overlap window
acceptance: the 'ships the N-1 clean siblings' test's concurrency check no longer relies on a bare 50ms setTimeout window; it stays green under load while still pinning that the two entries' afterMerge gates ran concurrently.
notes: tests/Dispatcher.test.ts:2712-2865, 'Parallelism probe' (setTimeout(r,50) at L2764, expect(maxInFlight).toBe(2) at L2785) is the one confirmed timing-dependent assertion in the file, swept per inbox request naming this file as suspect. Broader real-git-per-test scope question parked in open-questions.md, out of this entry's scope.
